body: ## Purpose
What happens when a Free workspace uses up its monthly included usage.
## Limits
- Free includes a fixed monthly amount of billed tokens and requests.
- Free has no overage: nothing beyond the included usage is ever charged, and Free workspaces never get an invoice.
## At the limit
Once a Free workspace reaches its monthly limit, further requests are rate-limited: the API returns HTTP `429` with error code `quota_exceeded` and a `Retry-After` header. Requests work again when the next month starts. To keep sending requests sooner, the customer upgrades to a paid plan.

This page documents recurring customer issues encountered during Hosted API key rotation/revocation.
# Issue 1: intermittent 401s after rotation
**Symptoms**
- Some requests succeed, some fail with 401.
**Likely cause**
- Customer updated one service but not all workloads (cron jobs, background workers, edge functions).
**Recommended fix**
- Search customer repos/infra for the old key name/secret reference.
- Deploy new secret everywhere.
- After validating all components, revoke the old key."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/known-issues-and-workarounds/usage-accounting-retries-and-stream-cancellation.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Usage accounting: retries and streaming cancellation", "status": "published", "date": "2025-02-18", "text": "## Common customer symptoms

3) Reduce max_tokens / output length to meet latency budgets.
